content:
ryan_pm: Quick sync — PolarisEdge B1 preview is green on NDA (signed EOD). Partner wants a 2-week preview window starting when hardware arrives. Need bench plan, telemetry hooks, and marketplace blurb. @maria.partners you okay to lead handoff?

maria.partners: yep, I'll own handoff. partner contact is Sam at Polaris (sam@polarisedge.io). arranging shipping docs now. ETA hardware: Tue next week.

polaris_contact: Hi all — Sam from Polaris here. Shipping manifest attached in email. Firmware bundle = 2.4.1-beta, default NVLink disabled, power cap set to 1200W. We'll provide serials once boxed.

kevin_ml: thanks Sam. for benchmarking: need model artifacts (HF or safetensors), example workloads, and a canonical prompt set. also will need logs at token-level and KV cache stats.

polaris_contact: we'll upload model zips to S3 link in our shared folder by EOD tomorrow. prompt sets next day.

anya_legal: quick flag — build addendum around telemetry retention + export controls for firmware telemetry. i'll draft a 1-pager and loop Sam for signature. no surprises but export control clause required for firmware-level traces.

tom_ops: lab slots Tue/Wed open. need exact rack U + PDUs. require 2x 20A circuits per rack, confirm if partner provides PDUs or we route with our spares. also power-on window request = 2 hours for burn-in.

maria.partners: Sam, can you confirm PDUs and whether devices ship with default IP on mgmt VLAN? we need serial -> asset tag mapping.

polaris_contact: they'll ship with mgmt IPs DHCP. PDUs included, but we prefer you use your spares for the first run. will attach serial->box mapping in the ship manifest.

kevin_ml: benchmark config suggestion (will use Redwood eval harness v2):
```json
{
  "model": "gptx-7b-sample",
  "sequence_length": 512,
  "batching": { "max_batch_size": 8, "max_latency_ms": 120 },
  "telemetry": ["token_latency_ms","kv_cache_hit","mem_usage_mb"]
}
```

kevin_ml: Also propose acceptance criteria: p99 latency < 120ms for seq512 @ batch<=4; throughput within 95% of our reference for same config; no OOMs in 24h soak.

ryan_pm: agreed on acceptance. add marketplace checklist: marketing blurb, logo, allowed screenshots (legal sign-off). @anya_legal — can you do a quick sign-off flow for the marketplace assets?

anya_legal: yes, i'll do marketing asset review after the telemetry addendum is done. hope to close both in 48h.

bench-bot: bench-run scheduled -> run id 2026-PE-B1-01. Command: `./run_bench --config pe_b1_v1.json --host 10.20.5.12` :rocket:

tom_ops: noted run id. will reserve rack Tue 09:00-12:00 for burn-in and initial bench. pls tag me in any emergency slack pings.

maria.partners: I'll collate checklist and send a single runbook by EOD today: shipping, lab steps, bench command, rollback, contact matrix.

polaris_contact: thanks all — Sam here. we'll try to get serials + S3 links by EOD. looking forward to the preview. :handshake:

ryan_pm: perfect. next check-in Thur morning. short action list: maria to publish runbook, kevin to prep harness, anya to draft addendum, tom to reserve rack, Sam to upload artifacts. :thumbsup:
